global: This shoyu ramen boasts a rich, dark broth, topped with tender chashu, crisp nori, and menma, all nestled in a white ceramic bowl. Warm, ambient light highlights the steam rising from the bowl, set against a wooden table.

regions.background: Wooden table surface shows warm brown tones, smooth grain patterns, and subtle scratches near edges.
regions.bowl: White ceramic ramen bowl with subtle speckles, smooth glossy surface, and a thin gold rim at the top edge.
regions.soup: Shoyu ramen broth with noodles, garnished with green onions, seaweed, and chopped garlic, appears rich, glossy, and savory.
regions.seaweed: Dark green nori seaweed, textured and slightly curled, sits in glossy broth with visible veins and edges.
regions.meat: The chashu pork is a golden-brown, tender-looking slice with visible fat marbling and two green onion garnishes on its surface.
regions.menma: Menma bamboo shoots appear golden-brown, slightly curled, with a fibrous texture and visible segmented surface.
